item.title: OnAir Pro 3.88
item.description:
What's New in OnAir Pro 3.88

  • Critical fix: ShellHelper pipe leak causing "Bad file descriptor" after hours of use.
  • Input Source menu: switch mic device during active recording without interruption.
  • Multi-segment mic recording: automatic concatenation when device changes mid-meeting.
  • PCM/WAV diagnostic logging at stop recording for troubleshooting.
  • Configuration screen adapts height for Free vs Pro.
  • Free version: no trace of recording features in menu or settings.
